title: Neutrino Slot Binding Topology
description: D1b / translator Phase 22B: the base organization -> participant -> slot hierarchy with stable ids and late-binding metadata, emitted alongside the slot wire contract (docs/spec/SLOT_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md). A later Binding Manifest names and validates an (organizationId, participantId, slotId) triple against this artifact. Advisory model metadata, NOT the wire contract: it is EXCLUDED from capabilityHash, and is emitted only when a source declares participants. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Validated by scripts/validators/validate_binding_topology.py.

crossOrganization.description: true iff two or more distinct named organizations participate (a null/unscoped org is not counted).

organizations.description: Non-empty: this artifact exists only when the source declares participants, so an empty topology is invalid.

organizationId.description: Declared trust/organization boundary; null for a participant with no declared org (the unscoped bucket).

slotId.description: Stable, unique abstract-slot id: `<capability>#<participantId>` in the base model.

lateBindingMode.description: fixed = statically bound by generation; to_be_bound = bound at realization time, governed by the fields below.

allowedRuntimes.description: Allowed runtime/backend families for a to_be_bound slot; empty for a fixed slot.

minAssurance.description: Minimum assurance floor. Static generation never claims above A1; a flexible slot may require more, satisfied only by runtime evidence.

evidenceProfile.description: Reserved: required evidence profile id, or null until the DSL models it.

authorizedBinder.description: Org/participant permitted to bind a to_be_bound slot (defaults to the participant's org). Absent for a fixed slot.
